name: TypeScript
description: Installs TypeScript and tsx as global npm packages, and configures VS Code for TypeScript/JavaScript development (ESLint, formatter defaults). Requires Node.js / npm to be installed first.

typescript.description: TypeScript version. 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.

tsx.description: tsx version (runs TypeScript files directly, replaces ts-node). 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.
